#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct {
    char *name;
    int count;
} entry_t;

int add_entry(entry_t *e, const char *name) {
    if (e == NULL || name == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }
    e->name = strdup(name);
    e->count += 1;
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    entry_t e = {0};
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        add_entry(&e, argv[i]);
    }
    printf("%s: %d\n", e.name, e.count);
    return 0;
}
